brief:
The United Nations warned Friday that Israel's forced displacement of entire Palestinian populations from three West Bank refugee camps last year could amount to crimes against humanity, Al-Monitor reported. The UN rights office described the operations in detail in a report that Israel swiftly rejected as biased and unfounded.

The assessment focused on mass displacement tactics used by Israeli forces against civilians sheltering in the camps. UN investigators documented how entire communities were removed from their homes, examining whether the operations met legal thresholds for crimes against humanity under international law.

Israel disputed the UN's findings and methodology. The report represents one of the most serious accusations leveled by the international body against Israeli military conduct in the occupied West Bank.
